Name: Nyapu Style Law and Order
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b]INSTRUCTIONS:[/b]
Unzip this file and drag it into your mods folder.
You should be prompted to replace some files.

[b]IMPORTANT! Make sure to change the portrait style to the "original" option in GMCM because those are the portraits my mod replaces.[/b]

If you need the file location:
Law and Order SV\[CP] Law and Order SV\assets\NPCs\Portraits_original


[b]UPDATES:[/b]
Added Spork and Ripley. 

[b]CREDITS:[/b]
Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/184157055]sdvhead[/url] for giving me permission to use your characters.
Big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for allowing me to use their base.
Retextures done by me, AhCuteArt

[b]NYAPU RETEXTURE PROGRESS:[/b]
Please check out my social media or Nexus profile.

Shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33255750]gwrnori[/url]. They did an amazing job on their Nyapu style portrait for Law and Order. By the time I realized someone else did an Nyapu style mod for Law and Order, it was already too late. (Feel free to mix and match mine with theirs. I think they did a better job on Russell than I did.)
